BU BET — BO'LIM MUQOVASI.

  Betda faqat bitta yozuv bor:
     PHOTO FILE SECTION

  Boshqa matn, rasm yoki mashq yo'q.


⚠ 'PHOTO FILE' NIMA DEGANI:

  'a photo file' = rasmlar to'plami

  'file' = 1) papka, to'plam
           2) fayl (kompyuterda)

  Ya'ni bu — kitobga ilova qilingan
  RASMLAR PAPKASI.


BUNDAN KEYIN NIMA BO'LADI:

  Har unit uchun ALOHIDA rangli rasmlar
  varag'i keladi:

     UNIT 1 — dunyo diqqatga sazovor
              joylari
     UNIT 2 — odamlar (tashqi ko'rinish)
     UNIT 3 — uy va xonalar
     ...va hokazo


⚠ VARAQLAR QIRQIB OLINADI:

  Har varaqning yuqorisida QAYChI belgisi
  (✂) va uzuq-uzuq chiziq bor.

  O'quvchi varaqni qirqib oladi va
  rasmlarni alohida KARTAlarga bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Grammar Book'dagi nazorat testlari ham
  shunday qirqib olinadi (75-87-betlar).


BU RASMLAR NIMA UChUN KERAK:

  1) SO'Z O'RGANISh — rasmga qarab so'zni
     eslash (tarjimasiz!)

  2) GAPIRISh MAShQI — rasm bo'yicha gap
     tuzish:
        'This is the Eiffel Tower.
         It's in Paris, France.'

  3) O'YIN — kartani ko'rsatib, sherik
     nomini aytadi

  4) TAKRORLASh — unitni tugatgach,
     kartalarni aralashtirib, nomlarini
     eslang


⚠ NEGA RASM TARJIMADAN YAXShI:

  Rasmga qaraganda miya so'zni TO'G'RIDAN
  ingliz tilida eslaydi — o'zbekcha orqali
  emas.

  Bu — tilni tezroq o'zlashtirish usuli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a photo     = surat
  a file      = papka, to'plam; fayl
  a section   = bo'lim
  a card      = karta
  scissors    = qaychi
  to cut out  = qirqib olmoq
  a landmark  = diqqatga sazovor joy

exercises.explanationUz:
BETDA 9 TA SURAT BOR — HAMMASI DUNYONING
MAShHUR JOYLARI.

⚠ Suratlar ostida NOM BOSILMAGAN. O'quvchi
rasmga qarab o'zi aytishi kerak — mashqning
maqsadi shu.


SURATLAR (chap ustundan boshlab):

  1) Giza piramidalari      — Misr
  2) Parfenon (Akropol)     — Yunoniston
  3) Sidney opera teatri    — Avstraliya
  4) Avliyo Vasiliy sobori  — Rossiya
  5) Toj Mahal             — Hindiston
  6) Oq uy                 — AQSh
  7) Eyfel minorasi        — Fransiya
  8) Big Ben               — Angliya
  9) Ozodlik haykali       — AQSh


⚠ NEGA AYNAN BU RASMLAR — UNIT 1 GA MOS:

  Unit 1 nomi — 'Hi!' (tanishuv).
  Uning asosiy mavzusi:
     'Where are you from?'
     'I'm from Egypt.'

  Word List'da (119-bet) Unit 1 da
  MAMLAKAT nomlari juda ko'p edi:
     Argentina, Brazil, Canada, China,
     Egypt, England, France, Greece,
     India, Italy, Japan, Mexico...

  Bu suratlar o'sha mamlakatlarni
  RASM orqali eslatadi.


⚠ IKKI SURAT BIR MAMLAKATDAN:

  Oq uy (Vashington) va Ozodlik haykali
  (Nyu-York) — ikkalasi ham AQShda.

  Demak 9 ta surat, 8 ta mamlakat.


GAP TUZISh QOLIPI:

  'This is the Eiffel Tower.
   It's in Paris, France.'

  'What is it? — It's Big Ben.'
  'Where is it? — It's in London.'


⚠ 'THE' QO'YILADIGAN NOMLAR:

  THE Eiffel Tower
  THE White House
  THE Statue of Liberty
  THE Taj Mahal
  THE Parthenon
  THE pyramids

  ⚠ 'the' YO'Q:
     Big Ben
     Sydney Opera House

  Qoida murakkab — bu nomlarni YODLASh
  kerak.


MAMLAKAT ↔ MILLAT (Unit 1 qoidasi):

  Egypt    → Egyptian   (misrlik)
  Greece   → Greek      (yunon)
  Australia → Australian (avstraliyalik)
  Russia   → Russian    (rus)
  India    → Indian     (hind)
  the USA  → American   (amerikalik)
  France   → French     (fransuz)
  England  → English    (ingliz)

  ⚠ Ko'pchiligiga '-AN' yoki '-ISH'
  qo'shiladi, lekin ISTISNOLAR bor
  (Greece → GREEK, France → FRENCH).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pyramid   = piramida
  an opera house = opera teatri
  a cathedral = sobor
  a tower     = minora
  a statue    = haykal
  liberty     = ozodlik
  a landmark  = diqqatga sazovor joy

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh VARAG'I.

  Oldingi varaqda (Unit 1, birinchi varaq)
  dunyo mashhur joylari bor edi.
  Bu varaqda esa ODAMLAR va YOZISh
  uchun joy.


BETDA TO'RTTA BO'LIM:

  1) BO'Sh RAMKA + yozuv:
     'put your photo here'
     = 'suratingizni shu yerga qo'ying'

     ⚠ Bu — O'ZINGIZ haqingizda yozish
     uchun!

  2) Sarg'ish sochli yosh ayol
     (qizil kiyimda)

  3) Ko'zoynakli, mo'ylovli o'rta yoshli
     erkak (yo'l-yo'l ko'ylak va galstukda)

  4) Mo'ylovli baquvvat erkak
     (oq ko'ylak va galstukda)

  Har birining yonida NUQTALI QATORLAR —
  yozish uchun.


⚠ BETDA BOShQA YOZUV YO'Q:

  Kitob mashq matnini bermagan. Vazifa
  faqat 'put your photo here' iborasidan
  va nuqtali qatorlardan tushuniladi.


NIMA YOZISh KERAK — UNIT 1 QOLIPI:

  Unit 1 nomi — 'Hi!' (tanishuv).
  Uning asosiy savollari:

     What's your name?
     How old are you?
     Where are you from?
     What do you do?

  Demak har surat yoniga shu savollarga
  javob yozish kerak.


NAMUNA — O'ZINGIZ HAQINGIZDA:

  'My name is Aziza. I am twelve years
   old. I am from Uzbekistan. I live in
   Tashkent. I am a student. My favourite
   sport is football.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Mening ismim Aziza. Men o'n ikki
   yoshdaman. Men O'zbekistondanman.
   Toshkentda yashayman. Men o'quvchiman.
   Sevimli sportim — futbol.'


NAMUNA — BOShQA ODAM HAQIDA:

  'This is Helen. She is about twenty-five
   years old. She is from England. She has
   got short fair hair and blue eyes.
   She is an actress.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Bu — Helen. U taxminan yigirma besh
   yoshda. U Angliyadan. Uning kalta och
   rangli sochi va ko'k ko'zlari bor.
   U aktrisa.'


⚠ 'I' va 'HE/ShE' FARQI — DIQQAT:

  O'ZINGIZ haqingizda:
     'I AM twelve.'  'I HAVE GOT blue
      eyes.'  'I LIVE in Tashkent.'

  BOShQA odam haqida:
     'She IS twelve.'  'She HAS GOT blue
      eyes.'  'She LIVES in London.'

  ⚠ 3-shaxsda fe'lga '-S' qo'shiladi:
     I live → she LIVES
     I have → she HAS


⚠ ODAMNI TANIShTIRISh — 'THIS IS':

  'THIS IS Helen.'  ✓
  'She is Helen.'   — shunchaki ism aytish

  Tanishtirishda DOIM 'This is ...'
  (Grammar 3-nazorat testi, 5-band).


⚠ SURATLARNI TASVIRLASh (Unit 2 lug'ati):

  2-surat: short FAIR hair, BLUE eyes,
           YOUNG, PRETTY
  3-surat: GLASSES, a MOUSTACHE,
           MIDDLE-AGED, DARK hair
  4-surat: a MOUSTACHE, WELL-BUILT,
           DARK hair

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar Word List'da (119-bet)
  Unit 2 bo'limida bor.


⚠ YOSHNI TAXMIN QILISh:

  'She is ABOUT twenty-five.'
  'He is IN HIS FORTIES.'
     = qirq yoshlarda

  'about' = taxminan


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  put ... here = shu yerga qo'ying
  glasses     = ko'zoynak
  a moustache = mo'ylov
  a tie       = galstuk
  striped     = yo'l-yo'l
  about       = taxminan
  yourself    = o'zingiz

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 2 - Look at the photos and describe the people: Amy, Eric, Frank, Max, Yoko, Lee, Lester.
exercises.explanationUz:
BETDA 7 TA ODAM — HAR BIRINING ISMI
BOSILGAN.

⚠ UNIT 1 VARAG'IDAN FARQI:

  UNIT 1 varag'ida nomlar YO'Q edi —
  o'quvchi joyni TANIB olishi kerak edi.

  UNIT 2 varag'ida ISMLAR BERILGAN —
  chunki vazifa boshqa: odamni
  TASVIRLASh.


UNIT 2 NING ASOSIY SAVOLLARI:

  'What does he/she LOOK LIKE?'
     → TAShQI KO'RINISh
     (tall, short, fair hair, blue eyes)

  'What IS he/she LIKE?'
     → XARAKTER
     (kind, funny, friendly)

  ⚠ Bu ikkisini chalkashtirish — eng ko'p
  uchraydigan xato (2-nazorat testi,
  8 va 9-bandlar).


TASVIRLASh QOLIPI:

  'This is Amy. She is old. She has got
   short white curly hair. She wears
   glasses.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Bu — Emi. U keksa. Uning kalta oq
   jingalak sochi bor. U ko'zoynak
   taqadi.'


⚠ 'HAVE GOT' va 'WEAR' FARQI:

  HAVE GOT → tana a'zolari
     'She HAS GOT blue eyes.'
     'He HAS GOT a moustache.'

  WEAR → kiyim, ko'zoynak
     'She WEARS glasses.'
     'He WEARS a tie.'

  ⚠ Ko'zoynak KIYILADI ('wear'),
  mo'ylov esa BOR ('have got').


⚠ ISMLAR TURLI MADANIYATLARDAN:

  Amy, Eric, Frank, Max, Lester
     → G'arb ismlari
  Yoko
     → Yapon ismi
  Lee
     → Xitoy/Koreya ismi

  Kitob ataylab turli xalq ismlarini
  qo'ygan — Unit 1 da mamlakat va millat
  mavzusi bo'lgani uchun.


⚠ IKKI JUFT SURAT:

  Eric va Frank — bitta suratda (aka-uka
     bo'lishi mumkin, ikkalasi ham chiziqli
     kiyimda)
  Yoko va Lee — bitta suratda (ikki qiz)

  Bu — TAQQOSLASh uchun qulay:
     'Eric is taller than Frank.'
     'Lee has got longer hair than Yoko.'


YOSh BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  KEKSA:        Amy
  O'RTA YOShLI: Lester
  YOSh:         Max
  BOLALAR:      Eric, Frank, Yoko, Lee


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a cardigan  = kofta
  a vest      = mayka (sport)
  a basketball = basketbol to'pi
  floral      = gulli (mato)
  striped     = chiziqli
  a fringe    = kokil (peshonaga tushgan
                soch)
  wrinkled    = ajinli

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — RASMLI XAT.

  Paula do'sti Vickyga yangi kvartirasi
  haqida yozadi. Matn ichida SO'Z O'RNIGA
  RASM qo'yilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  block of flats  (KITOBDA BERILGAN)
  2  bathroom
  3  fireplace
  4  window
  5  bed
  6  dressing table
  7  lamp
  8  bookcase
  9  pictures
 10  plants


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

──────────────────────────────────
  Dear Vicky,

  I am in my new flat, at last! It's on
  the seventh floor of a big BLOCK OF
  FLATS near the city centre. The flat is
  wonderful. It's got two bedrooms, a
  kitchen, a BATHROOM and a huge
  living-room with a FIREPLACE in it.

  My favourite room is my bedroom, because
  it's very pretty. It's got a blue carpet
  on the floor and a large WINDOW with a
  great view of the city.

  My comfortable BED is right next to the
  DRESSING TABLE. There is also a small
  table in the room with a telephone and a
  LAMP on it.

  I've got a big BOOKCASE, a large
  wardrobe, a TV and a CD player in my
  bedroom. I've also got some PICTURES on
  the walls. My bedroom has got a balcony,
  too. There are some PLANTS on it.

  Well, that's all for now. Come and see
  my new flat soon!

              Love,
              Paula
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'Aziz Vicky,

   Nihoyat yangi kvartiramdaman! U shahar
   markazi yaqinidagi katta ko'p qavatli
   binoning yettinchi qavatida. Kvartira
   ajoyib. Unda ikkita yotoqxona, oshxona,
   hammom va kaminli katta mehmonxona bor.

   Sevimli xonam — yotoqxonam, chunki u
   juda chiroyli. Polida ko'k gilam va
   shaharga ajoyib manzara ochiladigan
   katta deraza bor.

   Qulay karavotim kiyinish stoli yonida.
   Xonada yana telefon va chiroq turgan
   kichik stol bor.

   Yotoqxonamda katta kitob javoni, katta
   kiyim shkafi, televizor va CD pleyer
   bor. Devorlarda rasmlar ham bor.
   Yotoqxonamning balkoni ham bor. Unda
   gullar turibdi.

   Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada yangi
   kvartiramni ko'rgani keling!

              Mehr bilan,
              Paula'


⚠ NEGA BIRINChI JAVOB BERILGAN:

  Kitob 'block of flats' ni QIYShIQ
  harflar bilan yozib qo'ygan — bu
  NAMUNA.

  O'quvchi shundan vazifani tushunadi:
  rasmga qarab so'zni yozish kerak.


⚠ 2-JAVOB — 'BATHROOM', 'BATH' EMAS:

  Rasmda VANNA ko'rinadi, lekin gap
  XONALAR ro'yxati haqida:

     'two bedrooms, a kitchen, a ......
      and a huge living-room'

  Hammasi XONA — demak 'BATHROOM'
  (hammom), 'bath' (vanna) emas.


⚠ 4-JAVOB — 'WINDOW', 'CURTAINS' EMAS:

  Rasmda PARDALAR ko'rinadi, lekin gap:

     'a LARGE ...... with a great VIEW of
      the city'

  Manzara DERAZADAN ochiladi, pardadan
  emas. Yana 'a large' — BIRLIK, 'curtains'
  esa ko'plik.

  → WINDOW


⚠ 9 va 10-JAVOBLAR KO'PLIKDA:

     'some PICTURES'  (some + ko'plik)
     'some PLANTS'

  ⚠ 'some' dan keyin sanaladigan ot
  KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.


⚠ 'IT'S GOT' va 'THERE IS' FARQI:

  'The flat's GOT two bedrooms.'
     → EGALIK (kvartiraning nimasi bor)

  'THERE IS a small table in the room.'
     → MAVJUDLIK (xonada nima bor)

  Xatda ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan.


⚠ BRITANIYA QAVAT SANOG'I:

  'on the SEVENTH FLOOR'

  Britaniyada:
     ground floor = yerdagi qavat
     first floor  = undan YUQORIDAGI
     seventh floor = yerdan 8-qavat!

  Amerikada:
     first floor = yerdagi qavat


DO'STONA XAT QOLIPI:

  MUROJAAT — 'Dear Vicky,' (VERGUL bilan)
  YAKUN — 'Well, that's all for now.'
  TAKLIF — 'Come and see my new flat soon!'
  IMZO — 'Love, Paula'

  ⚠ Workbook 85-betdagi Maykalning xati
  bilan bir xil qolip.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a block of flats = ko'p qavatli turar-joy
                binosi
  a fireplace = kamin
  a dressing table = kiyinish stoli
  a bookcase  = kitob javoni
  a wardrobe  = kiyim shkafi
  a CD player = CD pleyer
  a balcony   = balkon
  a carpet    = gilam
  a view      = manzara
  at last     = nihoyat

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh VARAG'I.

  Ikkita uy surati va ikkita BO'Sh
  yozuv maydoni bor.

  ⚠ Kitob mashq matni BERMAGAN — vazifa
  suratlardagi YORLIQLARdan tushuniladi.


BETDAGI YORLIQLAR:

  'FOR RENT'  (ikkala uyda ham)
     = IJARAGA BERILADI

  'BARGAIN!'  (pastki uyda)
     = ARZON NARX! / QULAY TAKLIF!

  → Demak siz IJARA E'LONI yozasiz.


IKKI UY - IKKI XIL:

  1-UY (yuqorida):
     oq YOG'OCh uy, ikki qavatli,
     uchburchak tom, oq panjarali hovli,
     panjaraga suyalgan velosiped
     → a DETACHED HOUSE (alohida uy)

  2-UY (pastda):
     qizil G'IShTLI ko'p qavatli bino,
     temir panjarali balkonlar, pechak
     o'simligi, qora eshik
     → a BLOCK OF FLATS (kvartiralar
        binosi)

  ⚠ Bu farq MUHIM: 1-uyda BUTUN uy
  ijaraga beriladi, 2-uyda esa bitta
  KVARTIRA.


IJARA E'LONI QOLIPI:

──────────────────────────────────
  FOR RENT

  A beautiful house in the city
  centre.

  It's got three bedrooms, a large
  kitchen, two bathrooms and a
  living-room with a fireplace.

  There is a small garden with a
  white fence in front of the house.

  The rent is $800 a month.

  Phone: 555-2345
──────────────────────────────────


2-UY UChUN NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  BARGAIN!  FOR RENT

  A lovely flat on the third floor
  of a red brick building.

  It's got two bedrooms, a kitchen,
  a bathroom and a living-room with
  a big balcony.

  There are a lot of trees in the
  street.

  The rent is only $450 a month -
  a real bargain!

  Phone: 555-7788
──────────────────────────────────


⚠ E'LONDA NIMA BO'LISHI KERAK:

  1) UY TURI  — house / flat
  2) JOYI     — in the city centre /
                near the park
  3) XONALAR  — It's got ... / There is ...
  4) AFZALLIK — a garden, a balcony,
                a fireplace, a great view
  5) NARX     — The rent is ... a month.
  6) ALOQA    — Phone: ...


⚠ 'RENT' - FE'L HAM, OT HAM:

  FE'L:  'to rent a flat'
         = kvartira ijaraga olmoq

  OT:    'The rent is $500 a month.'
         = Ijara haqi oyiga 500 dollar.

  ⚠ 'FOR RENT' = ijaraga beriladi
     'FOR SALE' = sotiladi


⚠ 'BARGAIN' NIMA:

  'a bargain' = arzon, foydali xarid

  'It's a real bargain!'
     = Bu haqiqatan ham arzon!

  ⚠ 'to bargain' (fe'l) = savdolashmoq

  Word List 120-betda Unit 3 bo'limida bor.


⚠ 'A MONTH' - 'IN A MONTH' EMAS:

  'The rent is $500 A MONTH.'
     = oyiga 500 dollar (HAR OY)

  ⚠ Bu yerda 'a' = 'har', 'per' ma'nosida:
     twice A day    = kuniga ikki marta
     $50 A week     = haftasiga 50 dollar
     60 km AN hour  = soatiga 60 km


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  for rent    = ijaraga beriladi
  for sale    = sotiladi
  the rent    = ijara haqi
  to rent     = ijaraga olmoq/bermoq
  a bargain   = arzon xarid
  a fence     = panjara
  a brick     = g'isht
  a detached house = alohida turgan uy
  a garden    = bog', hovli
  an advertisement (an ad) = e'lon

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 5 - AROUND THE CLOCK WITH Annie Franklin. Write about her daily routine.
exercises.instructionUz: 5-UNIT — ANNI FRANKLIN BILAN KUN BO'YI. Uning kun tartibi haqida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh VARAG'I.

  Sarlavha berilgan, surat berilgan,
  qolgan joy BO'Sh.

  ⚠ Kitob mashq matni BERMAGAN — vazifa
  SARLAVHAdan tushuniladi.


SARLAVHA:

     AROUND THE CLOCK WITH
     ─────────────────────
       Annie Franklin


⚠ 'AROUND THE CLOCK' NIMA DEGANI:

  So'zma-so'z: 'soat atrofida'
  Ma'nosi: KUN BO'YI, sutka davomida,
           ertalabdan kechgacha

  Ya'ni: 'Anni Franklin bilan bir kun'

  ⚠ Bu — jurnal maqolalarining odatiy
  sarlavhasi: mashhur odamning kuni
  soatma-soat tasvirlanadi.

  Boshqa misollar:
     'The shop is open around the clock.'
     = Do'kon kechayu kunduz ochiq.


SURATDA KIM:

  Yosh ayol, yon tomondan olingan surat.
  Uzun to'q sariq-jigarrang soch, tepaga
  yig'ilgan, yuziga bir necha tola tushgan.
  Oq kiyim.

  ⚠ 2-unit varag'ida ham odamlar suratlari
  bor edi, lekin u yerda TAShQI KO'RINIShNI
  tasvirlash kerak edi. Bu yerda esa
  KUN TARTIBINI yozish kerak.


NAMUNA MAQOLA:

──────────────────────────────────
  AROUND THE CLOCK WITH
     ANNIE FRANKLIN

  Annie Franklin is a famous singer.
  She is twenty-four years old and
  she lives in London.

  She gets up at half past six every
  morning. She has a shower and
  then she has breakfast.

  At eight o'clock she goes to the
  music studio. She practises for
  four hours.

  She has lunch at one o'clock. In
  the afternoon she meets her
  friends or goes shopping.

  In the evening she often gives
  concerts. She usually gets home
  late and goes to bed at midnight.

  'I love my job,' she says.
──────────────────────────────────


⚠ 5-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI — PRESENT SIMPLE:

  Kun tartibi HAR KUNGI ish — shuning
  uchun PRESENT SIMPLE ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDA '-S' QO'ShILADI:

     I get up   →  She getS up
     I go       →  She goeS
     I have     →  She HAS  (⚠ tartibsiz!)
     I watch    →  She watchES
     I study    →  She studIES

  ⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: 'She get up' ✗
                    'She getS up' ✓


⚠ VAQT PREDLOGLARI:

     AT + aniq soat
        at seven o'clock, at midnight

     IN + kun qismi
        in the morning, in the afternoon,
        in the evening

     ON + kun
        on Monday, on Sundays

  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night' ('in' EMAS!)


⚠ TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI:

     always     (100%)  — doim
     usually    (90%)   — odatda
     often      (70%)   — tez-tez
     sometimes  (50%)   — ba'zan
     never      (0%)    — hech qachon

  ⚠ O'RNI: ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN
     'She USUALLY gets up early.'  ✓
     'She gets up usually early.'  ✗

  ⚠ LEKIN 'BE' dan KEYIN:
     'She is ALWAYS late.'  ✓


MAQOLANI QANDAY YOZISh:

  1) TANIShTIRISh — kim u, nechchi yoshda,
     qayerda yashaydi, kasbi nima
  2) ERTALAB — gets up, has a shower,
     has breakfast
  3) KUNDUZI — goes to work, works,
     has lunch
  4) KEChQURUN — gets home, watches TV,
     goes to bed
  5) IQTIBOS — 'I love my job,' she says.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  around the clock = kun bo'yi, sutka davomida
  a daily routine  = kun tartibi
  to get up        = uyg'onmoq, turmoq
  to have a shower = dush qabul qilmoq
  to practise      = mashq qilmoq
  to give a concert = konsert bermoq
  midnight         = yarim tun
  midday / noon    = tush payti
  famous           = mashhur

  mushuksimonlar) oilasiga kiradi.

⚠ IKKINChI RASM HAQIDA HALOL IZOH:

  Rasmda hayvonning KIChIK QULOQLARI
  ko'rinadi.

  Biologik jihatdan:
     'a seal' (haqiqiy tyulen) —
        tashqi QULOG'I YO'Q
     'a sea lion' / 'a fur seal' —
        kichik QULOG'I BOR

  turkumidan.

  so'zini o'rgatadi (Word List'da ham
  shu so'z bor). Shuning uchun javob:
  A SEAL.


HAYVONLAR HAQIDA GAP TUZISh:

  ⚠ ISTISNO: uy hayvonini (mushuk, it)

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 8 - Look at the pictures and write the words.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — RASMLI MATN.

  Matn ichida SO'Z O'RNIGA RASM
  qo'yilgan. Jami 17 ta rasm-so'z.

  Mavzu: BRITANIYALIKLAR NIMA YEYDI.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  NONUShTA:
     1  jam        (murabbo)
     2  cereal     (donli nonushta)
     3  tea        (choy)
     4  bacon      (cho'chqa go'shti tilimi)
     5  eggs       (tuxumlar)
     6  sausages   (kolbasachalar)
     7  tomatoes   (pomidorlar)

  TUShLIK:
     8  salad      (salat)
     9  sandwich   (buterbrod)
    10  pie        (pirog)

  KEChKI OVQAT:
    11  fish       (baliq)
    12  soup       (sho'rva)
    13  vegetables (sabzavotlar)
    14  fruit      (meva)
    15  chips      (kartoshka fri)

  YAKShANBA TUShLIGI:
    16  chicken    (tovuq)
    17  potatoes   (kartoshka)


TO'LIQ MATN (javoblar bilan):

──────────────────────────────────
  People in Britain usually have
  toast with JAM for breakfast, or
  CEREAL with milk. They drink
  instant coffee or TEA with milk.

  Sometimes, they have a traditional
  English breakfast. This includes
  BACON, EGGS, SAUSAGES, TOMATOES
  and some slices of toast.

  Lunch is a quick meal because most
  people are at work. They have a
  one-hour lunch break some time
  between 12 and 2pm. They usually
  have a light meal, such as a
  SALAD, a SANDWICH or a piece of
  PIE.

  Dinner is the main meal of the
  day. Most British people have
  dinner early, between 6 and 8pm.
  A traditional full dinner is FISH
  or SOUP, meat with VEGETABLES,
  and dessert - FRUIT or cheese -
  but nowadays not many British
  people have such a big dinner.

  Sometimes they buy fish and CHIPS
  or Chinese food from take-away
  restaurants instead.

  On Sundays, they usually have a
  traditional Sunday lunch. This is
  roast meat, such as CHICKEN or
  beef, with vegetables and roast
  POTATOES.
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'Britaniyada odamlar odatda nonushtaga
   murabboli tost yeyishadi yoki sutli
   donli nonushta. Ular eruvchan qahva
   yoki sutli choy ichishadi.

   Ba'zan ular an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasini
   qilishadi. Bunga bekon, tuxum, kolbasacha,
   pomidor va bir necha tilim tost kiradi.

   Tushlik — tez ovqat, chunki ko'pchilik
   ishda bo'ladi. Ularning soat 12 dan 2
   gacha bir soatlik tushlik tanaffusi bor.
   Odatda yengil ovqat: salat, buterbrod
   yoki bir bo'lak pirog.

   Kechki ovqat — kunning asosiy ovqati.
   Ko'pchilik britaniyaliklar erta, soat
   6 dan 8 gacha ovqatlanadi. An'anaviy
   to'liq kechki ovqat — baliq yoki sho'rva,
   sabzavotli go'sht va shirinlik: meva
   yoki pishloq. Lekin hozir ko'p
   britaniyaliklar bunday katta ovqat
   qilmaydi.

   Ba'zan ular buning o'rniga baliq va
   kartoshka fri yoki xitoy taomini
   olib ketish restoranlaridan sotib
   olishadi.

   Yakshanba kunlari odatda an'anaviy
   yakshanba tushligi bo'ladi. Bu —
   qovurilgan go'sht, masalan tovuq yoki
   mol go'shti, sabzavot va qovurilgan
   kartoshka bilan.'


⚠ KITOB XATOSI:

  Matnda yozilgan:
     'breakfast.This includes'

  Nuqtadan keyin BO'Sh JOY qo'yilmagan.
  To'g'risi:
     'breakfast. This includes'


⚠ SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALMAYDI (ko'plik yo'q):
     jam, cereal, tea, bacon, soup,
     fruit, chicken, fish, cheese

  SANALADI (ko'plikda yozildi):
     eggS, sausageS, tomatoES,
     vegetableS, chipS, potatoES

  ⚠ NEGA MUHIM:
     'How MUCH jam?'      (sanalmaydi)
     'How MANY eggs?'     (sanaladi)

     'a piece of pie'  — bo'lak bilan
     'a slice of toast' — tilim bilan


⚠ '-OES' KO'PLIK:

     tomato  → tomatOES
     potato  → potatOES

  ⚠ Undoshdan keyingi '-o' ga '-ES'
  qo'shiladi.

  ⚠ LEKIN: photo → photoS, piano → pianoS
  (chet so'zlar oddiy '-s' oladi).


⚠ BRITANIYA va AMERIKA FARQI:

     BrE 'chips'  = qovurilgan kartoshka
                    (yo'g'on)
     AmE 'chips'  = kartoshka chipsi!

     AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips'
     BrE 'crisps' = AmE 'chips'

exercises.instructionUz: 8-UNIT — Suratga qarang va restoran haqidagi taqrizni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh QOLIPI.

  ⚠ Oldingi yozish varaqlaridan FARQI:
  bu yerda kitob GAP BOShLARINI bergan.

  Siz bo'sh betdan emas, tayyor qolipdan
  boshlaysiz.


SURATDA NIMA:

  Kechqurun. Suv havzasi ustida qurilgan
  yog'och restoran. Ichkarida stol atrofida
  odamlar o'tirgan, chiroqlar yonyapti.
  Suvda qizil-oq KOI baliqlari suzyapti.
  O'ng tomonda daraxtlar, chapda yog'och
  qayiq.

  Restoran nomi: 'The Blue Lagoon'
     'a lagoon' = laguna (dengizdan ajralgan
                  sayoz suv havzasi)


KITOB BERGAN GAP BOShLARI:

  1  'The Blue Lagoon is the ............'
  2  'The food is ............'
  3  'A meal for two ............'
  4  'The Blue Lagoon is a ............'

  So'ng KITOBDA TO'LIQ BOSILGAN:
     '... Don't miss the chance to try its
      various dishes, but remember to book
      a table first (Tel.: 6620102).
      Enjoy your meal.'


TO'LDIRILGAN NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  The Blue Lagoon is THE BEST
  RESTAURANT IN TOWN. IT IS ON A
  SMALL LAKE AND YOU CAN SEE
  BEAUTIFUL FISH IN THE WATER.

  The food is DELICIOUS. THE MENU
  HAS GOT SOUP, FISH, CHICKEN AND
  VEGETABLES. THE FISH IS ALWAYS
  FRESH. THE WAITERS ARE FRIENDLY
  AND HELPFUL. THE MUSIC IS QUIET
  AND THE ATMOSPHERE IS ROMANTIC.

  A meal for two COSTS ABOUT $40.
  THAT IS NOT EXPENSIVE FOR SUCH A
  WONDERFUL PLACE.

  The Blue Lagoon is a GREAT PLACE
  FOR A SPECIAL EVENING.

  Don't miss the chance to try its
  various dishes, but remember to
  book a table first (Tel.: 6620102).
  Enjoy your meal.
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'The Blue Lagoon — shahardagi eng yaxshi
   restoran. U kichik ko'l ustida joylashgan
   va suvda chiroyli baliqlarni ko'rasiz.

   Ovqat mazali. Menyuda sho'rva, baliq,
   tovuq va sabzavot bor. Baliq har doim
   yangi. Ofitsiantlar mehribon va
   yordamchi. Musiqa sokin, muhit romantik.

   Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 40 dollar
   turadi. Bunday ajoyib joy uchun bu qimmat
   emas.

   The Blue Lagoon — maxsus kechalar uchun
   zo'r joy.

   Uning turli taomlarini tatib ko'rish
   imkoniyatini boy bermang, lekin avval
   stol band qilishni unutmang (Tel.:
   6620102). Yoqimli ishtaha.'


⚠ TAQRIZ TUZILIShI — 4 QISM:

  1) JOY — restoran qayerda, qanaqa
  2) OVQAT va XIZMAT — mazasi, menyu,
     ofitsiantlar, muhit
  3) NARX — 'A meal for two costs ...'
  4) XULOSA + TAVSIYA


⚠ 'THE' va 'A' FARQI — MUHIM!

  Kitob ataylab ikki xil artikl bergan:

  1-gap: 'is THE ...'
     → ANIQ, YAGONA narsa
     'the BEST restaurant'
     'the MOST BEAUTIFUL place'
     ⚠ 'the' + ORTTIRMA DARAJA

  4-gap: 'is A ...'
     → NOANIQ, ko'pdan biri
     'a GREAT place'
     'a WONDERFUL restaurant'
     ⚠ 'a' + ODDIY SIFAT

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 1-gapga ORTTIRMA DARAJA,
  4-gapga ODDIY SIFAT yozing!


⚠ ORTTIRMA DARAJA (superlative):

     good  → THE BEST      (eng yaxshi)
     bad   → THE WORST     (eng yomon)
     big   → THE BIGGEST   (eng katta)
     nice  → THE NICEST    (eng yoqimli)

  UZUN sifatlar 'THE MOST' bilan:
     beautiful → THE MOST BEAUTIFUL
     expensive → THE MOST EXPENSIVE

  ⚠ 'the' HAR DOIM kerak!


⚠ 'DON'T MISS' — BUYRUQ GAPI:

  'Don't miss the chance...'
     = imkoniyatni boy bermang

  Reklama va taqrizlarda BUYRUQ GAPI ko'p:
     'Don't miss...'  — boy bermang
     'Remember to...' — unutmang
     'Enjoy...'       — rohatlaning
     'Try...'         — tatib ko'ring


⚠ 'TO BOOK A TABLE':

  'to book' = oldindan band qilmoq
     'book a table' = stol band qilmoq
     'book a room'  = xona band qilmoq

  ⚠ 'a book' (OT) = kitob —
  bir xil so'z, ikki ma'no!

  ⚠ AmE: 'to make a reservation'


⚠ 'ENJOY YOUR MEAL':

  = Yoqimli ishtaha!

  Ofitsiant ovqat keltirganda aytadi.

  ⚠ Boshqa variantlar:
     'Bon appetit!' (fransuzcha, ingliz
      tilida ham ishlatiladi)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a lagoon    = laguna
  a review    = taqriz, sharh
  a dish      = taom; likobcha
  various     = turli-tuman
  to book     = band qilmoq
  a chance    = imkoniyat
  to miss     = boy bermoq; sog'inmoq
  delicious   = mazali
  fresh       = yangi (ovqat haqida)
  the menu    = menyu
  a waiter    = ofitsiant
  the atmosphere = muhit
  to cost     = turmoq (narx)
  Enjoy your meal! = Yoqimli ishtaha!

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 11 - Use the notes to write the story 'Sammy the Wonder Horse'.
exercises.instructionUz: 11-UNIT — Qaydlardan foydalanib 'Sammy the Wonder Horse' hikoyasini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — QAYDLARDAN HIKOYA TUZISh.

  Ikkita surat va besh qayd berilgan.
  Qaydlar TO'LIQ GAP EMAS — faqat
  so'zlar, qiya chiziq (/) bilan
  ajratilgan.

  Siz ulardan TO'LIQ GAP tuzasiz.


SARLAVHA:

  'Sammy the Wonder Horse'
     = Sammi — mo''jizakor ot

  ⚠ 'the Wonder Horse' — ismdan keyin
  keladigan LAQAB.

  Shu qolip: 'Alexander the Great'
             (Iskandar Zulqarnayn)
             'Ivan the Terrible'
             (Ivan Grozniy)


KITOB BERGAN BESh QAYD:

  1-SURAT (daraxt tagida yozayotgan qiz):

  1) warm summer day/Sally/sit/under/
     big tree/next to/house

  2) she/want/write/story/for/
     competition/in/school magazine

  3) Suddenly/Sally/hear her horse/
     make/strange noise

  2-SURAT (o'qituvchiga qog'oz uzatayotgan
           qiz):

  4) Mr Thomas/her teacher/give/her/
     first prize/for/story competition

  5) Sally/feel/really happy/to be/winner


⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:

  Qaydlar hikoyaning faqat
     BOShI (1-3) va OXIRI (4-5)
  ni beradi.

  O'RTASI YO'Q!

  Otning g'alati ovozi bilan nima bo'ldi?
  Salli nima haqida hikoya yozdi?
  Nega ot 'mo''jizakor' deb ataladi?

  ⚠ Buni o'quvchi O'ZI O'YLAB TOPADI.
  Vazifaning eng qiziq qismi shu.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  SAMMY THE WONDER HORSE

  It was a warm summer day. Sally
  was sitting under a big tree next
  to the house.

  She wanted to write a story for a
  competition in the school
  magazine.

  Suddenly, Sally heard her horse
  make a strange noise.

  [O'RTASI - O'ZINGIZ O'YLANG]
  She ran to the field. Sammy was
  standing next to a hole in the
  ground. A little dog was in the
  hole! Sammy was making a noise
  because he wanted to help. Sally
  pulled the dog out and took it
  home. Then she wrote a story
  about her clever horse.

  Mr Thomas, her teacher, gave her
  first prize for the story
  competition.

  Sally felt really happy to be the
  winner.
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'SAMMI — MO''JIZAKOR OT

   Iliq yoz kuni edi. Salli uy yonidagi
   katta daraxt tagida o'tirar edi.

   U maktab jurnalidagi tanlov uchun
   hikoya yozmoqchi edi.

   To'satdan Salli otining g'alati ovoz
   chiqarayotganini eshitdi.

   [O'rtasi] U dalaga yugurdi. Sammi
   yerdagi chuqur yonida turardi.
   Chuqurda kichkina it bor edi! Sammi
   yordam bermoqchi bo'lgani uchun ovoz
   chiqarayotgan edi. Salli itni tortib
   chiqardi va uyga olib ketdi. Keyin u
   aqlli oti haqida hikoya yozdi.

   Janob Tomas, uning o'qituvchisi, unga
   hikoya tanlovi uchun birinchi o'rin
   sovrinini berdi.

   Salli g'olib bo'lganidan juda xursand
   bo'ldi.'


⚠ QAYDDAN GAPGA — NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  Qayd:
     'warm summer day/Sally/sit/under/
      big tree'

  Gap:
     'IT WAS A warm summer day. Sally
      WAS SITTING under A big tree.'

  ⚠ QO'ShILGANLAR:
     • ARTIKLLAR — a, an, the
     • FE'L ZAMONI — sit → was sitting
     • BOG'LOVChILAR — and, but, because
     • 'It was...' qolipi
     • BOSh HARF va NUQTA


⚠ HIKOYA O'TGAN ZAMONDA YOZILADI:

  ⚠ TARTIBSIZ FE'LLAR (bu betda):

     sit   → SAT / was SITTING
     hear  → HEARD
     give  → GAVE
     feel  → FELT
     write → WROTE
     run   → RAN
     take  → TOOK

  ⚠ TO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
     want  → wantED
     pull  → pullED

  ⚠ Barcha shakllar 116-betdagi
  Irregular Verbs jadvalida bor.


⚠ PAST SIMPLE va PAST CONTINUOUS:

  'Sally WAS SITTING under a tree'
     → UZOQ DAVOM ETGAN holat (fon)

  'Suddenly she HEARD a noise'
     → BIRDANIGA bo'lgan hodisa

  ⚠ Qoida:
     FON        → was/were + -ing
     HODISA     → Past Simple

  ⚠ 'Suddenly' so'zi HAR DOIM Past Simple
  bilan keladi.


⚠ 'HEAR SB DO' — 'TO' YO'Q!

     'She heard her horse MAKE a noise.'
        ✓ ('to make' EMAS)

  Shu qolipdagi fe'llar:
     hear sb DO   — eshitmoq
     see sb DO    — ko'rmoq
     watch sb DO  — kuzatmoq
     make sb DO   — majburlamoq
     let sb DO    — ruxsat bermoq


⚠ VERGULLI IZOH:

  'Mr Thomas, HER TEACHER, gave her...'

  Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH
  (kim ekanini tushuntiradi).

  ⚠ Ikkala vergul ham KERAK.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a wonder     = mo''jiza
  wonderful    = ajoyib
  a competition = tanlov
  a prize      = sovrin
  first prize  = birinchi o'rin sovrini
  a winner     = g'olib
  to win       = yutmoq
  a noise      = ovoz, shovqin
  strange      = g'alati
  suddenly     = to'satdan
  a magazine   = jurnal
  a field      = dala
  a hole       = chuqur, teshik

tasks.en: QAYD:  warm summer day/Sally/sit/under/big tree/next to/house   →   It was a warm summer day. Sally was sitting under a big tree next to the house.

'the house' — ARTIKLLAR.

⚠ 'sit' → 'WAS SITTING' — davom etgan

⚠ 'hear' TARTIBSIZ: 'HEARD'.

⚠⚠ 'hear sb DO' — 'TO' QO'YILMAYDI!

⚠ 'Suddenly' — Past Simple bilan keladi,
Past Continuous bilan emas.

ni bergan.

Javobsiz savollar:

  • Salli nima haqida hikoya yozdi?

⚠ Vazifaning eng qiziq qismi shu —
sarlavha ('Wonder Horse') javobga ishora
beradi: ot QANDAYDIR YAXSHILIK qilgan.

⚠ VERGULLI IZOH: 'Mr Thomas, HER TEACHER,
gave...' — ikki vergul orasidagi qism kim
ekanini tushuntiradi. IKKALA vergul kerak.

⚠ 'feel happy TO BE' — sifatdan keyin
'to' + fe'l (sabab bildiradi).

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 12 - Use the information in the table to complete the article about Antwerp.
exercises.instructionUz: 12-UNIT — Jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Antverpen haqidagi maqolani to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MA'LUMOTDAN MAQOLA TUZISh.

  YUQORIDA — tayyor JADVAL (qisqa
     qaydlar).
  PASTDA — maqola QOLIPI (bo'sh
     qatorlar).

  Vazifa: jadvaldagi qisqa qaydlarni
  TO'LIQ GAPlarga aylantirish.


⚠⚠ QAYChI BELGISIGA E'TIBOR BERING:

  Boshqa varaqlarda qaychi betning
  YUQORISIDA edi — butun varaq qirqib
  olinardi.

  Bu betda qaychi O'RTADA — jadvaldan
  PASTDA.

  ⚠ Demak faqat MAQOLA qismi qirqiladi,
  JADVAL kitobda qoladi.

  Sababi: jadval — ma'lumot manbai,
  yozayotganda ko'z oldingizda turishi
  kerak.


KITOB BERGAN JADVAL:

  ACCOMMODATION (turar joy):
     Rosier - expensive, but very
        luxurious hotel
     Hilton - biggest hotel in the city
        centre

  PLACES TO VISIT (ko'riladigan joylar):
     the Brabo Fountain - take photographs
     the Cathedral - see paintings by
        Paul Rubens
     The National Maritime Museum - learn
        about the history of Antwerp
     Antwerp Zoo - one of the biggest in
        Europe

  EATING OUT (tashqarida ovqatlanish):
     Maritime - excellent seafood
        restaurant
     Sir Anthony Van Dijck - restaurant
        with delicious traditional
        French-Belgian cuisine

  SHOPPING (xarid):
     Meir - main shopping street with lots
        of boutiques and Belgian chocolate
        shops
     the diamond quarter - buy or look at
        the beautiful diamonds

  NIGHTLIFE (tungi hayot):
     bars and cafes - listen to live jazz
        music
     De Singel - see an opera


KITOBDA BOSILGAN QISMLAR:

  KIRISh (qiyshiq harflar bilan):
     'This beautiful city in northern
      Belgium has diamonds, beautiful
      buildings and lots more.'

  XULOSA (o'ng pastda):
     'Antwerp has so much to offer - it's
      beautiful, it's interesting and
      there is always something to do
      there. For a great holiday in a
      northern European city, try
      Antwerp.'


TO'LDIRILGAN NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  ANTWERP

  This beautiful city in northern
  Belgium has diamonds, beautiful
  buildings and lots more.

  ACCOMMODATION
  You can stay at the Rosier. It is
  expensive, but it is a very
  luxurious hotel. The Hilton is the
  biggest hotel in the city centre.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  You can take photographs of the
  Brabo Fountain. Go to the
  Cathedral and see the paintings by
  Paul Rubens. At the National
  Maritime Museum you can learn about
  the history of Antwerp. Don't miss
  Antwerp Zoo - it is one of the
  biggest in Europe.

  EATING OUT
  The Maritime is an excellent
  seafood restaurant. At the Sir
  Anthony Van Dijck you can try
  delicious traditional French-Belgian
  cuisine.

  SHOPPING
  Meir is the main shopping street.
  There are lots of boutiques and
  Belgian chocolate shops. In the
  diamond quarter you can buy or look
  at the beautiful diamonds.

  NIGHTLIFE
  Listen to live jazz music in the
  bars and cafes. You can also see an
  opera at De Singel.

  Antwerp has so much to offer - it's
  beautiful, it's interesting and
  there is always something to do
  there. For a great holiday in a
  northern European city, try
  Antwerp.
──────────────────────────────────


⚠ QAYDDAN GAPGA — UCh XIL YO'L:

  Qayd:
     'Antwerp Zoo - one of the biggest
      in Europe'

  1) 'IT IS' bilan:
     'Antwerp Zoo IS one of the biggest
      in Europe.'

  2) 'YOU CAN' bilan:
     'YOU CAN visit Antwerp Zoo.'

  3) BUYRUQ GAPI bilan:
     'DON'T MISS Antwerp Zoo!'

  ⚠ Sayohat maqolasida uchalasi ham
  aralashtirib ishlatiladi — matn
  jonli chiqadi.


⚠ SAYOHAT MAQOLASI TILI:

  ⚠ 'YOU' — o'quvchiga murojaat:
     'You can stay at...'
     'You can try...'

  ⚠ BUYRUQ GAPI — taklif:
     'Go to the Cathedral.'
     'Don't miss the Zoo!'
     'Try Antwerp.'

  ⚠ KUChLI SIFATLAR:
     luxurious  = hashamatli
     excellent  = a'lo
     delicious  = mazali
     beautiful  = go'zal


⚠ ORTTIRMA DARAJA (jadvalda ikki marta):

     'the BIGGEST hotel'
     'one of the BIGGEST in Europe'

  ⚠ 'ONE OF THE + ORTTIRMA + KO'PLIK':
     'one of the biggest zooS'
     'one of the best restaurantS'

  ⚠ Ma'nosi: 'eng kattalaridan BIRI'
  (eng kattasi emas!)


⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION' — YOZILIShI QIYIN:

     a-c-c-o-m-m-o-d-a-t-i-o-n

  ⚠ IKKI 'c' va IKKI 'm'!

  ⚠ Sanalmaydigan ot:
     'accommodations' ✗ (BrE)


⚠ 'CUISINE' — FRANSUZChA SO'Z:

  'cuisine' [kwi-ZIN] = milliy taomlar
     'French-Belgian cuisine'
     = fransuz-belgiya taomlari

  ⚠ 'kitchen' (oshxona) EMAS!


ANTVERPEN HAQIDA:

  • Belgiyaning shimolida, Flandriya
    o'lkasida.
  • Dunyodagi ENG YIRIK OLMOS savdo
    markazi.
  • Rassom Rubens shu shaharda ishlagan.
  • Yirik dengiz porti (shuning uchun
    'Maritime Museum' bor).

  ⚠ HALOL IZOH: kitobda 'Paul Rubens'
  yozilgan. Rassomning to'liq ismi —
  PETER Paul Rubens (1577-1640).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  accommodation = turar joy
  luxurious    = hashamatli
  a fountain   = favvora
  a cathedral  = sobor
  maritime     = dengizga oid
  a museum     = muzey
  a zoo        = hayvonot bog'i
  seafood      = dengiz mahsulotlari
  cuisine      = milliy taomlar
  a boutique   = butik, kichik do'kon
  a diamond    = olmos, brilliant
  a quarter    = mahalla; chorak
  nightlife    = tungi hayot
  live music   = jonli musiqa
  to offer     = taklif qilmoq
  excellent    = a'lo

tasks.en: UNIT 12 - Use the information in the table to complete the article about Antwerp.
tasks.uz: 12-UNIT — Jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Antverpen haqidagi maqolani to'ldiring.

tasks.en: ACCOMMODATION:  Rosier - expensive, but very luxurious hotel / Hilton - biggest hotel in the city centre   →   You can stay at the Rosier. It is expensive, but it is a very luxurious hotel. The Hilton is the biggest hotel in the city centre.
tasks.uz: Siz Rosier mehmonxonasida qolishingiz mumkin. U qimmat, lekin juda hashamatli. Hilton — shahar markazidagi eng katta mehmonxona.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION' — IKKI 'c' va IKKI 'm'!

⚠ Sanalmaydi: 'accommodations' ✗ (BrE).

⚠ 'the biggEST' — orttirma daraja,
'the' bilan.

'luxurious' = hashamatli.

tasks.en: PLACES TO VISIT:  the Cathedral - see paintings by Paul Rubens   →   Go to the Cathedral and see the paintings by Paul Rubens.
tasks.uz: Soborga boring va Paul Rubensning suratlarini ko'ring.
tasks.note:
⚠ BUYRUQ GAPI — sayohat maqolasida ko'p
ishlatiladi: 'Go to...', 'See...',
'Don't miss...'.

⚠ 'paintings BY Rubens' — muallif oldidan
'BY' ('of' EMAS).

⚠ HALOL IZOH: rassomning to'liq ismi —
PETER Paul Rubens (1577-1640). Kitob
'Peter' ni tushirib qoldirgan.

tasks.en: PLACES TO VISIT:  Antwerp Zoo - one of the biggest in Europe   →   Don't miss Antwerp Zoo - it is one of the biggest in Europe.
tasks.uz: Antverpen hayvonot bog'ini o'tkazib yubormang — u Yevropadagi eng kattalaridan biri.
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ 'ONE OF THE + ORTTIRMA + KO'PLIK':
  'one of the biggest zooS'  ✓
  'one of the biggest zoo'   ✗

⚠ Ma'nosi: 'eng kattalaridan BIRI' —
eng kattasi EMAS!

tasks.en: EATING OUT:  Sir Anthony Van Dijck - restaurant with delicious traditional French-Belgian cuisine   →   At the Sir Anthony Van Dijck you can try delicious traditional French-Belgian cuisine.
tasks.uz: Sir Anthony Van Dijck restoranida mazali an'anaviy fransuz-belgiya taomlarini tatib ko'rishingiz mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'cuisine' [kwi-ZIN] = MILLIY TAOMLAR.
⚠ 'kitchen' (oshxona) EMAS!

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'Van Dijck' — rassom Anthony
van Dyck (1599-1641) ismining FLAMANDCHA
yozilishi. Restoran nomi bo'lgani uchun
bu shakl to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.

tasks.en: SHOPPING:  the diamond quarter - buy or look at the beautiful diamonds   →   In the diamond quarter you can buy or look at the beautiful diamonds.
tasks.uz: Olmos mahallasida chiroyli brilliantlarni sotib olishingiz yoki tomosha qilishingiz mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a quarter' IKKI MA'NO:
  1) MAHALLA (shahar qismi) - bu yerda
  2) ChORAK ('a quarter past five')

⚠ Antverpen — dunyodagi eng yirik OLMOS
savdo markazi. Shuning uchun kirishda ham
'has diamonds' yozilgan.

tasks.en: NIGHTLIFE:  bars and cafes - listen to live jazz music / De Singel - see an opera   →   Listen to live jazz music in the bars and cafes. You can also see an opera at De Singel.
tasks.uz: Bar va kafelarda jonli jaz musiqasini tinglang. De Singelda operani ham ko'rishingiz mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'LIVE music' [layv] = JONLI musiqa
(yozib olingan emas).
⚠ 'to live' [liv] (yashamoq) bilan bir xil
yoziladi, LEKIN boshqacha o'qiladi!

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'De Singel' — Antverpendagi
san'at markazi. Shahardagi opera teatri
odatda 'Vlaamse Opera' deb ataladi.

tasks.en: Antwerp has so much to offer - it's beautiful, it's interesting and there is always something to do there.
tasks.uz: Antverpen juda ko'p narsa taklif qiladi — u go'zal, qiziqarli va u yerda doim qiladigan ish topiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ KITOBDA BOSILGAN — yozish shart emas.

'to have so much to offer' = juda ko'p
narsa taklif qilmoq.

⚠ 'something to DO' — otdan keyin 'to' +
fe'l.

⚠ 'it's' (= it is) — apostrof BOR.

Rasmli kartalar bilan ishlashning asosiy

sentencePatterns.formula: What is it?  —  Where is it?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is it? — It's Big Ben. Where is it? — It's in London.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is the Eiffel Tower. It's in Paris, France.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu — Eyfel minorasi. U Parijda, Fransiyada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Asosiy qolip. Shahar oldin, mamlakat keyin.

sentencePatterns.formula: What is it?  —  It's [nom].   Where is it?  —  It's in [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is it? — It's Big Ben. Where is it? — It's in London.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu nima? — Bu Big Ben. U qayerda? — Londonda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki kishilik o'yin: biri kartani ko'rsatadi,
ikkinchisi javob beradi.

Mamlakat → millat qoidasini mashq qilish
uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: My name is [ism]. I am [son] years old. I am from [mamlakat]. I am a [kasb].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My name is Aziza. I am twelve years old. I am from Uzbekistan. I am a student.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening ismim Aziza. O'n ikki yoshdaman. O'zbekistondanman. O'quvchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'ZINGIZ haqingizda yozish qolipi ('I' bilan).

sentencePatterns.formula: This is [ism]. He/She is about [son]. He/She has got [soch] hair and [rang] eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Helen. She is about twenty-five. She has got short fair hair and blue eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu — Helen. U taxminan yigirma besh yoshda. Kalta och rangli sochi va ko'k ko'zlari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tanishtirishda 'THIS IS ...';
3-shaxsda 'HAS GOT' ('have got' emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: He wears [kiyim] and he has got [yuz belgisi].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He wears glasses and he has got a moustache.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ko'zoynak taqadi va mo'ylovi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'WEAR' — kiyim va ko'zoynak uchun;
'HAVE GOT' — tana a'zolari uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is [ism]. He/She is [yosh]. He/She has got [soch]. He/She wears [kiyim].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Amy. She is old. She has got short white curly hair. She wears glasses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu — Emi. U keksa. Kalta oq jingalak sochi bor. Ko'zoynak taqadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Asosiy qolip: ism → yosh → soch → kiyim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Eric is taller than Frank. Lee has got longer hair than Yoko.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Erik Frankdan baland. Lining sochi Yokonikidan uzunroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki juft surat (Eric+Frank, Yoko+Lee)
ataylab TAQQOSLASH uchun qo'yilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: He HAS GOT [tana a'zosi], but he doesn't WEAR [kiyim].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Max has got a moustache, but he doesn't wear glasses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maksning mo'ylovi bor, lekin ko'zoynak taqmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'HAVE GOT' — tana a'zosi;
'WEAR' — kiyim va ko'zoynak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's got two bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a huge living-room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unda ikkita yotoqxona, oshxona, hammom va katta mehmonxona bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a small table in the room. There are some plants on it.

⚠ BIRLIK → 'there IS';
KO'PLIK → 'there ARE'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My comfortable bed is right next to the dressing table.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's on the [tartib son] floor of a [bino].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's on the seventh floor of a big block of flats.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A beautiful house in the city centre.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a tiger. It's orange and black.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu — yo'lbars. U to'q sariq va qora rangda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Hayvon uchun 'IT' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The lion has got a big mane and a long tail.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sherning katta yoli va uzun dumi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'have got' — egalik.
⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda 'HAS got'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It lives in Africa. It eats meat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Afrikada yashaydi. U go'sht yeydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'liveS', 'eatS' — 3-shaxs birlik '-s'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It can run very fast. It can swim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda tez yugura oladi. U suza oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda —
'to' YO'Q, '-s' ham YO'Q.
'It can runs' ✗

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: People in Britain usually have toast with jam for breakfast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Britaniyada odamlar odatda nonushtaga murabboli tost yeyishadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'FOR breakfast' — ovqat mahali oldidan
'for'.
⚠ 'have' = yemoq (bu yerda 'egalik' emas).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This includes bacon, eggs, sausages, tomatoes and some slices of toast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bunga bekon, tuxum, kolbasacha, pomidor va bir necha tilim tost kiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.
⚠ Ro'yxatda oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... a light meal, such as a [A], a [B] or [C].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They usually have a light meal, such as a salad, a sandwich or a piece of pie.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular odatda yengil ovqat yeyishadi: salat, buterbrod yoki bir bo'lak pirog.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = masalan, ... kabi.
⚠ Misol keltirish uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ovqat] is the main meal of the day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dinner is the main meal of the day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat — kunning asosiy ovqati.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'the main meal' — aniq artikl,
chunki bittagina asosiy ovqat bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Blue Lagoon is the best restaurant in town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: The Blue Lagoon — shahardagi eng yaxshi restoran.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'THE' berilgan — ORTTIRMA DARAJA kerak.
'the best', 'the most beautiful'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The food is delicious and the waiters are friendly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqat mazali, ofitsiantlar esa mehribon.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'food' SANALMAYDI → 'IS';
'waiters' KO'PLIK → 'ARE'.

sentencePatterns.formula: A meal for two costs about [narx].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A meal for two costs about $40.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 40 dollar turadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'costS' — 3-shaxs birlik.
'about' = taxminan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Blue Lagoon is a great place for a special evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: The Blue Lagoon — maxsus kecha uchun zo'r joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu yerda 'A' berilgan — ORTTIRMA DARAJA
EMAS, oddiy sifat.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was a warm summer day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iliq yoz kuni edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Hikoyani boshlashning eng keng tarqalgan
qolipi. Qaydda 'It was' yo'q — o'zingiz
qo'shasiz.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sally was sitting under a tree. Suddenly, she heard a strange noise.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salli daraxt tagida o'tirar edi. To'satdan u g'alati ovoz eshitdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ FON — Past Continuous;
HODISA — Past Simple.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sally heard her horse make a strange noise.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salli otining g'alati ovoz chiqarayotganini eshitdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ 'TO' QO'YILMAYDI!
'heard her horse MAKE' ✓

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mr Thomas, her teacher, gave her first prize.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Janob Tomas, uning o'qituvchisi, unga birinchi o'rin sovrinini berdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH.
Ikkala vergul ham kerak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sally felt really happy to be the winner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salli g'olib bo'lganidan juda xursand bo'ldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sifatdan keyin 'to' + fe'l — SABAB
bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can stay at the Rosier. You can try delicious cuisine at the Sir Anthony Van Dijck.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Siz Rosierda qolishingiz mumkin. Sir Anthony Van Dijckda mazali taomlarni tatib ko'rishingiz mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'you' — o'quvchiga to'g'ridan murojaat.
⚠ 'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Joy] is one of the [orttirma] + KO'PLIK in [hudud].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Antwerp Zoo is one of the biggest zoos in Europe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Antverpen hayvonot bog'i — Yevropadagi eng katta bog'lardan biri.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠⚠ 'one of the' dan keyin KO'PLIK.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Go to the Cathedral and see the paintings by Paul Rubens.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soborga boring va Rubensning suratlarini ko'ring.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ GAPI — taklif bildiradi.
⚠ 'paintings BY [rassom]'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Antwerp has so much to offer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Antverpen juda ko'p narsa taklif qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Maqolani yakunlash qolipi.
⚠ 'something to DO' — otdan keyin 'to'+fe'l.
